Status of a required property

Source: R/csdg_property_status.R
csdg_property_status.Rd

Convenience constructors for the three statuses of a required property (Step 4 of the article). Judged against its criterion, a required property is supported if the observation meets the criterion, contradicted if the observation shows that the property does not hold, and open if the criterion, the evidence, or a completed computation is missing, or if the observation falls into the inconclusive zone of the criterion. The constructors return the strings that csdg_evidence_record() accepts as status, checked against the vocabulary of the package, so a misspelled status cannot enter a claim record.

The open status is constructed by open_status() rather than open(), so that the package does not mask base::open().

Usage

supported()

contradicted()

open_status()

Value

A string: "supported", "contradicted", or "open".

See also

csdg_evidence_record(), csdg_adjudicate_claim(), csdg_claim_record_template().

Examples

supported()
#> [1] "supported"
contradicted()
#> [1] "contradicted"
open_status()
#> [1] "open"

csdg_evidence_record(
  "G5", TRUE, "required_property", status = supported(),
  rationale = "The ordering is the same in every fold.",
  required_property = "The ordering persists when the quantity is estimated again.",
  observation = "Item 1 ranks above item 2 in all five folds.",
  relevance_to_proposition = "Folds vary the training data while the model and perturbation stay fixed."
)
#> <CSDGEvidenceRecord> G5 
#>   Role: required property 
#>   Status: supported 
#>   Property: The ordering persists when the quantity is estimated again. 
#>   Observation: Item 1 ranks above item 2 in all five folds.
